AboutUs.title: About Us
AboutUs.description: EituEbenezer is an international Pentecostal evangelical Christian university dedicated to sharing the love of Christ and transforming lives through the power of the Holy Spirit.
AboutUs.historyText: What was once known as Maranatha Bible Seminary, Inc., founded in 1973, has today become EituEbenezer Theological College and University, Inc. It was established in 2015 as the official body of the Christian Education Department of the EituEbenezer Pentecostal Council, Inc., to bring Theological Education to a higher level of academic excellence.
AboutUs.missionText: Our mission is to train men and women who pursue a life of service to the Lord through the biblical standards of the Christian faith. This will be achieved by providing our students with a higher, multidimensional and pluralistic Christian theological education.
AboutUs.visionText: To strive to be a model institution that will contribute to the betterment of our society, training specialized and spiritual Christian leaders who will carry out our mission by promoting moral values based on the biblical foundations of the Christian faith.

1.description: God has allowed me to develop as a worship minister, and to be a student and teacher at our institution for more than 10 years. I am convinced that in God's heart, EITU is exactly what our motto declares: The ministerial school of approved workers.

2.description: I am deeply committed to the mission of Ebenezer International Theological University, and I firmly believe in the vision of preparing, training, and empowering individuals for service in the Kingdom of God.

3.description: If I had to recommend anything, it would be this university, because it is incredible. I love what I have learned and the wonderful unity found within it. I love every aspect of this university, and it has helped me build my foundations.

4.description: At the university, God has called me to be a Professor and Director of the Chaplaincy department. The greatest calling is to be a servant of the Most High God. EITU has been a great blessing to me.

5.position: A leader with a vision of eternity.

Master's degree in Administration and currently pursuing a Master's degree in Educational Management to strengthen the institution. I leave a legacy that transcends generations, promoting the Great Commission. Glory to Jesus Christ!

Chaplaincy.title: Ebenezer International Community Chaplains Association
Chaplaincy.tagline: Bringing the presence of Christ to every community through compassion, service, and excellence.

about.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: The Ebenezer International Community Chaplains Association (EICCA) is a community-focused chaplaincy organization committed to equipping, developing, and supporting chaplains who have been called to serve individuals, families, churches, institutions, and communities.
EICCA seeks to bring the presence of Christ to every community through compassion, service, spiritual care, ethical leadership, and excellence.
Our chaplains are prepared to minister in a variety of settings, including hospitals, nursing homes, hospice care, correctional facilities, law enforcement agencies, and other community environments.

We believe that effective chaplaincy requires both spiritual preparation and professional responsibility. Therefore, EICCA emphasizes continuing education, ethical conduct, confidentiality, accountability, leadership development, community outreach, and compassionate care.

vision.heading: Our vision
vision.quote: To bring the presence of Christ to every community through compassion, service, and excellence.
vision.intro: EICCA envisions a united body of spiritually mature and professionally prepared chaplains, equipped to serve diverse communities with:
items: Compassion and understanding
Spiritual maturity
Integrity and humility
Professional excellence
Ethical responsibility
Respect for every person
Commitment to community service
A heart devoted to prayer and spiritual care
Readiness to respond to people in times of crisis, grief, need, and transition
vision.closing: Our vision is to see chaplains positioned and prepared to serve wherever there is a need for spiritual support, compassionate presence, encouragement, and community care.

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.statement: The mission of EICCA is to equip, develop, and mobilize chaplains to provide compassionate spiritual care and meaningful community service while maintaining high standards of ethical, professional, and spiritual conduct.
items: Providing continuing education and professional development.
Developing spiritually mature and accountable chaplain leaders.
Providing training in spiritual care, crisis response, and community ministry.
Encouraging prayer, Bible study, fasting, and spiritual preparation.
Supporting chaplains through mentorship and leadership development.
Promoting community outreach and service.
Encouraging ministries that serve vulnerable and underserved populations.
Establishing standards of confidentiality, ethical conduct, and professional boundaries.
Promoting accountability among chaplains and district leadership.
Fostering unity and collaboration throughout the organization.
Preparing chaplains to serve in hospitals, hospice care, correctional facilities, law enforcement agencies, nursing homes, and other community settings.
Representing Christ through compassionate service and respectful care.

items.title: Faith
items.text: We recognize that prayer, Scripture, spiritual preparation, and dependence on God are foundational to effective chaplaincy.

items.title: Compassion
items.text: We serve people with empathy, kindness, dignity, and understanding, especially in times of crisis, grief, illness, hardship, and transition.

items.title: Service
items.text: We believe chaplaincy is a ministry of presence and action. We seek opportunities to serve individuals and communities through practical assistance, outreach, prayer, and encouragement.

items.title: Integrity
items.text: We expect chaplains and leaders to conduct themselves with honesty, responsibility, humility, and accountability.

items.title: Excellence
items.text: We are committed to continuous learning, preparation, professionalism, and excellence in every area of chaplaincy service.

items.title: Respect
items.text: We honor the dignity and worth of every person and strive to provide care without discrimination or inappropriate judgment.

items.title: Confidentiality and ethical responsibility
items.text: We recognize the importance of protecting personal information, maintaining appropriate boundaries, practicing confidentiality, and complying with applicable ethical and professional standards.

items.title: Unity
items.text: We believe effective ministry requires cooperation among chaplains, district leaders, organizational leadership, churches, institutions, and community partners.

items.title: Leadership
items.text: We develop leaders who are spiritually grounded, professionally prepared, accountable, and committed to serving others.

items.title: Community
items.text: We strive to be present where people live, work, worship, recover, grieve, and face difficult circumstances.

commitment.heading: Our commitment
commitment.intro: EICCA is committed to developing chaplains who are prepared not only to minister to people, but also to serve people appropriately and effectively.
commitment.closing: Our goal is to prepare chaplains who can enter difficult situations with a compassionate presence, provide appropriate spiritual support, serve with professionalism, and demonstrate the love of Christ through their words, actions, and service.

gallery.heading: Gallery
gallery.description: Moments of service, training, and community from our chaplains.

humanTalent.title: Human Talent Management
humanTalent.description: Develop the skills to attract, train and retain talent in organizations and churches. This course blends human resources strategy with biblical principles of service and stewardship, enabling you to lead teams with efficiency, empathy and purpose. You will learn recruitment, performance evaluation, workplace climate and professional development from both a managerial and a pastoral perspective. Ideal for those who manage people and want to maximize their potential with ethics and strategic vision.

executiveLeadership.title: Executive Leadership
executiveLeadership.description: A program designed to form high-impact leaders who combine authority, humility and vision. You will explore contemporary leadership models, decision-making, effective communication and change management, applied to both corporate and ministry settings. Building on your managerial and theological experience, this course equips you to influence positively, inspire teams and lead organizations toward sustainable results with integrity and eternal purpose.

theologyDiploma.title: Diploma in Theology
theologyDiploma.description: Deepen your biblical, doctrinal and practical knowledge to strengthen your ministry and teaching. This diploma covers systematic theology, hermeneutics, church history and Christian ethics, giving you solid tools to interpret Scripture faithfully and apply it with contemporary relevance. Ideal for pastors, leaders and teachers who want to ground their service in biblical truth and communicate it with clarity and passion.

internationalBachelor.title: International Bachelor’s Program
internationalBachelor.description: High-level academic training with a global outlook, designed for those seeking professional and ministerial excellence. This program brings together educational management, leadership, theology and administration, preparing you to serve competently in international contexts. You will develop critical thinking, research skills and strategic vision, with an approach that honors biblical values and responds to the challenges of today’s world.

internationalAssociate.title: International Associate Program
internationalAssociate.description: A gateway to higher education with international standards. This program provides solid foundations in leadership, administration, theology and service, allowing you to begin or complement your academic and ministerial development. Flexible and practical, it equips you to serve effectively in churches, organizations and communities, laying a firm foundation to continue on to higher levels of study.

trainerOfTrainers.title: Trainer of Trainers
trainerOfTrainers.description: Equip those who teach and disciple others. This course prepares you to design, facilitate and evaluate learning processes with teaching excellence and a biblical foundation. You will learn instructional methods, educational planning, learning assessment and spiritual mentoring, multiplying the impact of your ministry. Ideal for teachers, leaders and pastors who want to form generations of believers and professionals with doctrinal soundness and practical competence.

churchAdministration.title: Church Administration
churchAdministration.description: Learn to manage the church with order, transparency and strategic vision. This course covers planning, finances, team leadership, organizational communication and resource management, all from a biblical and managerial perspective. It equips you to administer with both efficiency and spirituality, caring for people as well as processes, and ensuring the church’s mission is fulfilled with excellence and faithfulness.

churchPlanters.title: Church Planters
churchPlanters.description: A program for those who sense the call to start and multiply churches with a biblical foundation and contemporary strategy. You will explore vision, evangelism, discipleship, leadership and the organization of new congregations, with practical tools for urban and rural contexts. With a pastoral and missional perspective, this course prepares you to sow with wisdom, water with perseverance and reap fruit that endures for the glory of God.

Testimonials.title: Testimonials
Testimonials.description: Listen to the stories of transformation and how God has worked in the lives of our members.

1.content: EituEbenezer has been a place where I found my purpose in Christ. The community here is truly a family that has supported me through the hardest moments of my life.

2.content: Watching God transform the lives of young people through our ministry is an incredible experience. Every day I see the power of the gospel in action.

3.content: When I arrived at EituEbenezer, I was lost and without direction. Today I can say that I have found my identity in Christ and a clear purpose for my life.

4.content: Being part of the missions team has allowed me to see how God works in different cultures and contexts. It's an experience that has transformed my perspective on the gospel.

intro.heading: 1. Introduction
intro.text: At EituEbenezer Pentecostal Evangelical Christian University (hereinafter, "EituEbenezer"), we value and respect the privacy of our visitors, members, collaborators and website users. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your personal data. By using our website or sharing your data with us, you accept the terms of this policy.

dataCollected.heading: 2. Data we collect
items: Full name
Email address
Phone number
Mailing address (if applicable)
Contact information for activities, events or donations
Messages sent through contact forms
Technical data such as IP address, browser type and site usage statistics (cookies)

purpose.heading: 3. Purpose of data processing
items: Managing communication with our members and visitors
Sending newsletters, devotionals and event announcements
Managing records of activities, meetings, services and worship gatherings
Managing donations and issuing receipts when applicable
Responding to requests or questions made by users
Improving the browsing experience on our website

legalBasis.heading: 4. Legal basis for data processing
items: Express consent of the data subject
Compliance with legal or tax obligations
EituEbenezer's legitimate interest for pastoral, administrative or communication purposes

sharing.heading: 5. Data sharing
sharing.intro: EituEbenezer does not sell, rent or share personal data with third parties, except in the following cases:
items: When required by law or by a competent authority
With technology service providers who help us operate the website (for example, hosting or email delivery), always under confidentiality agreements
With your explicit consent

cookies.heading: 6. Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.text: Our website only uses cookies and local storage that are strictly necessary to remember your language and theme preference. We do not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. See our Cookie Policy for details and for how to manage them.

rights.heading: 7. User rights
items: Access your personal data
Rectify inaccurate or incomplete data
Request the deletion of your data when it is no longer necessary
Object to processing or request its limitation
Withdraw your consent at any time
rights.contactText: To exercise these rights, you can contact us through the email

retention.heading: 8. Data retention
retention.text: We will retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described and to comply with applicable legal obligations.

security.heading: 10. Data security
security.text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure or destruction.

changes.heading: 11. Changes to this policy
changes.text: We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this same page along with their update date.

siteUse.heading: 1. Use of the website
siteUse.text1: The website of EituEbenezer Pentecostal Evangelical Christian University is intended to share information about our activities, Christian teachings, and spiritual content.
siteUse.text2: Use of this site implies acceptance of these Terms of Service.

contentOwnership.heading: 2. Content ownership
contentOwnership.text: All published content (text, images, videos, audio, documents) belongs to EituEbenezer, unless otherwise indicated. Its reproduction or distribution without prior authorization is prohibited, especially for commercial purposes.

properUse.heading: 3. Proper use
properUse.text: Use of this site is expected to be respectful and in line with Christian principles. Use of the content for mockery, defamation, or any purpose contrary to the faith and values we promote is not permitted.

externalLinks.heading: 4. External links
externalLinks.text: This site may include links to external pages. We are not responsible for the content of third-party sites.

contact.heading: 5. Contact
contact.intro: For any inquiries regarding the use of the site, you can contact us at:

changes.heading: 6. Changes to these terms
changes.text: We may modify these Terms at any time. Modifications will be posted on this same page along with their update date.

whatAre.heading: 1. What are cookies?
whatAre.text: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser. Similar technologies, such as local storage (localStorage), serve a similar purpose. In this policy we use the term “cookies” to refer to both.

used.heading: 2. Cookies we use
used.intro: This site only uses first-party cookies that are strictly necessary or store a preference, created when you change the language or theme. We do not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, and we do not share browsing data with advertising networks.

thirdParty.heading: 3. Third-party services
items: Location map: our contact page shows an OpenStreetMap map. To display it, your browser downloads map images from OpenStreetMap Foundation servers, which receive technical data such as your IP address and browser type, under their own privacy policy.
External links: if you click links to WhatsApp, social networks or other sites, those services may use their own cookies. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies.

consent.heading: 4. Consent
consent.text: The cookies we use are strictly necessary or created at your request, so applicable law does not require prior consent for them. If we add analytics or marketing cookies in the future, we will ask for your consent before enabling them and will update this policy.
